issue.title: Module range mismatch in "ActionImpl::set_actuator_async" function
issue.body:
Hi,
I think I might have just found a minor bug in the ["set_actuator_async"](https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK/blob/fadfe22e7c053945107201e2638be9a7f8b8ee5c/src/mavsdk/plugins/action/action_impl.cpp#L516) function.
The range in the switch...case statement goes from 1 to 6 while the range of the module function (index % 6) goes from 0 to 5.
So, param6 will never be set and if (index==6), then param7 will be equal to 1 and the whole command will be ignored by PX4 [handle_message_command_both](https://github.com/PX4/PX4-Autopilot/blob/1c8ab2a0d7db2d14a6f320ebd8766b5ffaea28fa/src/modules/mavlink/mavlink_receiver.cpp#L557) function.

If I understood correctly, at the moment PX4 only pays attention to 3 AUX outputs, namely param1, param2 and param3... so this bug should not have any effect on the whole system behavior.

comments.body:
Hi, thanks for the issue. That looks indeed a bit odd.
I can see the discussion back here: https://github.com/mavlink/MAVSDK-Proto/pull/217/files#r596590938 

What would be your suggestion how to fix it?
Ok, would that be according to the MAVLink spec then?
I think so. The MAVLink spec is implemented in the "command" structure, isn't it?
Oh, now it dawned on my :man_facepalming:! Can you make a pull request to fix it? That would be great, thanks.
Sure, I will make it ASAP (i.e. this coming weekend) 👍

This issue has been mentioned on **Discussion Forum for PX4, Pixhawk, QGroundControl, MAVSDK, MAVLink**. There might be relevant details there:

https://discuss.px4.io/t/set-actuator-not-working/33933/4
